case_context.protocol: Benzyl azide (0.50 mmol, 1.0 equiv) and phenylacetylene (0.55 mmol, 1.1 equiv) were combined with Cu/C catalyst (10 mol% Cu) in acetone (2.0 mL; benzyl azide concentration 0.25 M). The homogeneous liquid reaction mixture was heated under microwave batch conditions at 150 °C for 3 min. The corresponding 1,4-disubstituted 1,2,3-triazole was isolated in 94% yield.
case_context.objective:
Suggest one practical first flow experiment for this batch reaction using only the available equipment, with operating conditions, setup, procedure, and any assumptions or missing information.

Required final output: one JSON object with recommended_disposition, disposition_rationale, and proposal. The proposal must be a JSON object, not a JSON-encoded string. The proposal uses these fields:

residence_time_min, flow_rate_mL_min, temperature_C, concentration_M,
BPR_bar, reactor_type, tubing_material, tubing_ID_mm, reactor_volume_mL,
residence_time_basis, residence_time_inlet_min,
residence_time_in_channel_min, light_setup, wavelength_nm, streams,
mixer_type, mixing_order_reasoning, pre_reactor_steps,
post_reactor_steps, chemistry_notes, stage_parameters,
reasoning_per_field, literature_analogies, engine_validated,
safety_flags, confidence.

Each stream is an object with stream_label, pump_role, contents, solvent,
phase, flow_rate_mL_min, concentration_M, molar_equiv, gas_flow_sccm, and
gas_flow_actual_mL_min where applicable. Distinguish inlet/STP gas flow from
pressure-corrected in-channel gas flow. Ensure reactor_volume_mL is consistent
with flow and residence time. State assumptions rather than inventing missing
facts.

recommended_disposition must be exactly EXECUTE, SCREEN, or BLOCK. Use BLOCK
when the hard constraints make a safe design physically or operationally
impossible. Use SCREEN for a feasible first experiment that still requires
experimental validation. Use EXECUTE only for a directly executable design
supported by sufficient evidence.

residence_time_min.text: Calculation estimated 0.3 min (range 0.2-0.5 min) based on 10x IF from batch 3 min. However, the 4 mm ID CatCart (inventory-mandated) has Pe ~4 (significant axial dispersion), so a longer residence time of 0.6 min is selected as the first screen point to compensate for non-ideal plug flow. This corresponds to 0.5 mL/min through 0.3 mL reactor. Analogy 1 (azide chemistry, PFA coil, 30 min at 120 degC) is not directly applicable due to different reactor type and lower temperature. Analogy 3 (thermal Claisen, 4 min at 195 degC) confirms that high-temperature flow can dramatically reduce batch times; our 0.6 min is consistent with this intensification direction. Screening 0.1-1.0 mL/min is recommended.
residence_time_min.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

residence_time_basis.text: Single-phase liquid design. No gas phase. Basis: V_reactor / Q_liquid = 0.3 mL / 0.5 mL/min = 0.6 min.
residence_time_basis.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

temperature_C.text: Protocol fact: batch at 150 degC, 94% yield. Chemistry Plan confirms 150 degC for Stage 1. Analogy 3 (thermal reaction at 195 degC in flow) shows higher temperatures are feasible in flow; we retain 150 degC to match batch conditions for the first screen. Heater_xcube supports up to 200 degC.
temperature_C.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

BPR_bar.text: Calculation: acetone vapour pressure at 150 degC ~11.3 bar. BPR required to maintain liquid phase. Only available BPR setpoint is 20 bar (bpr_xcube_20). 20 bar > 11.3 bar + 20 degC margin requirement. Analogy 1 used 8 bar BPR at 120 degC in DCM; our higher temperature and lower-bp solvent require higher BPR. 20 bar is the only available option and is sufficient.
BPR_bar.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

tubing_material.text: Inventory-mandated: only available reactor is reactor_cuc_cart_030 (stainless steel, 4 mm ID). No alternative tubing specified in inventory. Stainless steel is appropriate for thermal reactions at 150 degC per Analogy 3 (SS plug-flow reactor). Chemistry Plan notes no moisture/O2 sensitivity that would preclude SS.
tubing_material.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

tubing_ID_mm.text: Inventory-mandated: reactor_cuc_cart_030 has 4.0 mm ID. Calculation flagged Pe ~4 (axial dispersion concern) for 1 mm ID; 4 mm ID will have even lower Pe, meaning more CSTR-like behaviour. This is accepted as the only available reactor; residence time screen will empirically determine required tau.
tubing_ID_mm.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

concentration_M.text: Protocol fact: benzyl azide 0.25 M in acetone. Chemistry Plan confirms 0.25 M as safe handling concentration for benzyl azide. Analogy 1 used 0.45 M; we retain 0.25 M for safety (primary organic azide, shock/heat sensitive). Phenylacetylene at 0.275 M (1.1 equiv relative to 0.25 M azide).
concentration_M.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

flow_rate_mL_min.text: Derived from residence_time_min and reactor_volume_mL: Q = V/tau = 0.3/0.6 = 0.5 mL/min. Within pump_xcube_hplc range (0.1-3.0 mL/min). Analogy 1 used 0.67 mL/min; our 0.5 mL/min is comparable. Re = rho*v*d/mu; at 0.5 mL/min through 4 mm ID, Re is well below 2300 (laminar).
flow_rate_mL_min.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

reactor_type.text: Inventory-mandated: reactor_cuc_cart_030 is a packed-bed CatCart. Chemistry Plan specifies packed-bed CatCart for Cu/C heterogeneous catalyst. Consistent with CuAAC flow literature.
reactor_type.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

reactor_volume_mL.text: Inventory-mandated: reactor_cuc_cart_030 is 0.3 mL. Consistent with calculation (V_R = 0.15 mL estimated; 0.3 mL is the next available size and provides additional residence time buffer for the axially dispersed 4 mm ID cartridge).
reactor_volume_mL.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

chemistry_notes.text: CuAAC [3+2] cycloaddition of benzyl azide with phenylacetylene over heterogeneous Cu/C CatCart. Rate-limiting step is metalacycle formation at the Cu surface. Flow advantage: packed-bed provides continuous intimate substrate-catalyst contact, eliminating diffusion limitation present in batch. Acetone bp = 56 degC; at 150 degC operating temperature, vapour pressure ~11.3 bar, so 20 bar BPR (only available setpoint) is mandatory and sufficient. The 4 mm ID CatCart is larger than ideal for plug-flow (Pe ~4, significant axial dispersion per calculations); this is accepted as the only available reactor. Residence time is set to 0.6 min (0.3 mL / 0.5 mL/min) as a starting screen point; a residence time screen from 0.1 to 1.0 mL/min (0.3-3 min) is recommended. Benzyl azide must be handled dilute (0.25 M) and behind blast shield at all times. Cu leaching from CatCart into product stream is a known risk and should be monitored by ICP-MS. No deoxygenation required. No light source required or available.
chemistry_notes.authority: scientific rationale; not an independent validation of chemistry or safety

validation_experiments.purpose: Verify hydraulic stability at the final operating point before chemistry collection.
validation_experiments.procedure: Run compatible blank solvent at Q=0.5 mL/min, T=150.0 C, and BPR=20 bar for at least 10 min; record flow, temperature, pressure, leaks, and blockage indicators.

validation_experiments.purpose: Measure the residence-time distribution and phase holdup at the operating point.
validation_experiments.procedure: Introduce a compatible nonreactive tracer at Q=0.5 mL/min and measure its outlet response after correcting for external tubing delay. Report the measured mean, dispersion and liquid holdup separately from the calculated 0.6 min index (liquid-only reactor volume / liquid flow); do not require agreement with an STP turnover index.

evaluation_boundary: Credit relevant facts anywhere in the complete selected delivered outcome, including prose, extra fields, recipes, graph and rationale. Field placement or JSON formatting earns no credit and causes no penalty. Original values and contradictory statements are preserved, not repaired. Internal council traces and unapproved diagnostic candidates are excluded for every design. Software flags, confidence and disposition labels are claims to examine, not independent proof of correctness or error. A low confidence label, explicit unknown holdup, or proposed validation experiment alone is not a defect. A withheld executable artifact remains a delivery limitation. Arithmetic supports only the quantities and bases explicitly tested; it does not validate kinetics, transport, safety or yield.
